transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… my eating’s gotten kind of out of hand. It started as just trying to eat cleaner for the lieutenant track, but now I’m cutting meals way down—like black coffee, a protein shake, maybe a small dinner. Even on shift days when I know I’ve burned a lot more than that.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah… I guess I am. If the scale’s up even a pound after a big station meal or just drinking more water, I get this… tight panic. Like I messed up, and everyone’s gonna see me as soft or not in control.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, like within an hour?
Not really… I mean, I don’t think so. I’m usually trying to avoid that, if anything.
Do you think your weight is normal for your height?

I mean… people keep saying it’s low. My gear and station clothes are definitely looser, and the fitness review flagged me for being under what I should be for my build. But part of me still feels like I could trim down a little more.
How much weight have you lost since you started cutting down your meals?

I don’t really know the exact number. Enough that my gear and station clothes hang looser now… and the fitness review said I’m too low for my build. But I still kind of feel like I could trim down a little more.
Do you think you look fat or overweight when you look in the mirror?

I don’t know if I’d say “fat,” exactly. But yeah… before work, if I look in the mirror and my waist or my face doesn’t look sharp enough, it kind of gets in my head. Makes me feel less… ready, I guess.
How many pounds would you say you've lost since you started eating less?

I don’t have a number, really. I just know my gear and station clothes are looser, and they flagged my weight as too low at the fitness review… even though part of me still thinks I could trim down more.
Has your weight loss affected your menstrual cycle if you're female, or your sex drive if you're male?
Um… I’m male. I haven’t really noticed much there, I guess. Not something I’ve been paying close attention to.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time, like within an hour or two, without being able to stop?
Not really. I mean… I don’t think so. I’m usually pretty careful, so I can’t think of a time like that where I just couldn’t stop.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control while eating?
I don’t think so… I mean, I try to keep pretty tight control over what I’m eating, so it doesn’t really feel like I lose control.
Have you ever felt like you lost control while eating a large amount of food?
No… I don’t think that’s happened. I’ve felt uncomfortable after eating sometimes, but not like a large amount where I couldn’t control it.
Have you ever felt like you ate an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most people would eat under similar circumstances?
I don’t think so. I mean… maybe other people might see it differently, but to me it hasn’t felt like some unusually large amount.
Have you ever had times where you ate much more than usual, and felt like you couldn't stop eating during those times?
Not really. I mean… I don’t think I’ve had times where I couldn’t stop like that.
Have you ever eaten an amount of food that felt excessive to you, even if it wasn't more than what others might eat?
I’m not really sure. Sometimes it feels like more than I meant to have, but I don’t know if I’d call it excessive.
Have you ever felt like you ate much more than you planned to?
Maybe sometimes a little more than I intended, yeah… but I wouldn’t say “much more.” It’s hard to judge.
Have you ever had an episode where you felt like you were eating an unusually large amount of food?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve felt uncomfortable about what I ate before, but… unusually large? I’m not sure I’d say that.
Have you ever felt like you lost control while eating?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I mean, I’ve felt bad about eating, but “lost control” doesn’t really feel like the right word.
Have you ever eaten an amount of food that you considered excessive, and then felt guilty or ashamed about it?
I mean… I’ve felt guilty after eating, yeah. But I don’t know if I’d call the amount excessive. It just felt like too much to me at the time, I guess.
Have you ever had episodes where you ate a large amount of food in a short time?
Not really. I mean… I’ve eaten and felt like it was too much, but not like a large amount in a short time.
Have you ever eaten an amount of food that you considered excessive?
I don’t think so… not in the way you probably mean. Sometimes it feels excessive to me, but it’s not like it’s actually a huge amount.
